title: Dinner Plate Stacks
description: Design a set of stacks such that we push and pop values from the leftmost non-full stack and a specified stack index, maintaining capacity.
pseudocode:
1. push(val): find first non-full stack index i
2. stacks[i].push(val)
3. popAtStack(index): remove element from stack[index]
4. pop(): remove from last non-empty stack

steps.note: Pushing 1: No stacks exist, create stack 0.
Pushing 2: Stack 0 has capacity, add to it.
Pushing 3: Stack 0 is full (cap 2), create stack 1.
pop(): Remove from last non-empty stack (stack 1).
